634:t_1:87.en:
$$グラハム$$
「...I've been ashamed of myself until today... And when I can finally bring myself to speak to him, it's under circumstances like these.」

634:t_1:88.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But I don't consider the days until now wasted. I've finally realized what I must do.」

634:t_1:90.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I was once a man who repeatedly acted foolishly in an attempt to surpass $$ガンダム$$.」

634:t_1:91.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But that thinking was wrong after all. The one I must surpass is this young man.」

634:t_1:92.en:
$$フェルト$$
($$刹那$$'s existence changed the Major...)

634:t_1:93.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm going. Please stay by his side.」

634:t_1:99.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「...$$イアン$$, $$リンダ$$. All adjustments to the $$クアンタ$$ are complete.」

634:t_1:100.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it's finally complete in the truest sense.」

634:t_1:101.en:
$$イアン$$
「Sharing consciousness through $$脳量子波$$ within a high-density particle field, connecting people's feelings across the battlefield...」

634:t_1:102.en:
$$リンダ$$
「A machine made to stop fighting...」

634:t_1:103.en:
$$イアン$$
「That is... the $$ガンダム$$ $$刹那$$ wanted, the $$クアンタ$$.」

634:t_1:104.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Using this machine to show the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ we mean no harm is the hope humanity has left, then.」

634:t_1:105.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' numbers are enormous. In a contest of strength, humanity will eventually exhaust itself...」

634:t_1:106.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But with $$刹那$$ himself in that state...」

634:t_1:107.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アレルヤ$$... Couldn't you pilot this thing?」

634:t_1:108.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「With $$脳量子波$$ only as strong as mine or $$マリー$$'s, we can't bring out the $$クアンタ$$'s true capabilities.」

634:t_1:109.en:
$$マリー$$
「This machine is meant for an $$イノベイター$$.」

634:t_1:110.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then what about our $$ガンダム$$ veteran, or $$カミーユ$$ or $$バナージ$$...?」

634:t_1:111.en:
$$イアン$$
「They could certainly meet the requirement for the quantity of $$精神感応波$$, but...」

634:t_1:114.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Because of the difference between $$ニュータイプ$$s' and $$イノベイター$$s' characteristics.」

634:t_1:115.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I thought they were similar, since both emit psychic waves...」

634:t_1:116.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「So the two really are different?」

634:t_1:117.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This is my own view, but $$イノベイター$$s exist within the broader category of $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

634:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you saying $$刹那$$ is a $$ニュータイプ$$ too?」

634:t_1:119.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If he had been born in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, he would have awakened as a $$ニュータイプ$$.」

634:t_1:120.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$刹那$$ was born in $$ＡＤＷ$$ and exposed to GN particles.」

634:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So the presence of GN particles is what determines the difference between $$ニュータイプ$$s and $$イノベイター$$s?」

634:t_1:122.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Exactly. $$刹那$$... $$イノベイター$$s can use GN particles as a medium to extend their consciousness.」

634:t_1:123.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Compared to $$ニュータイプ$$s, who use psychic waves to communicate with specific people, $$イノベイター$$s' chief trait is broader consciousness sharing, regardless of the other party.」

634:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. It was probably for what $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ wanted to achieve.」

634:t_1:126.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I think he wanted the humans of a new era who would one day emerge to have the power to share consciousness more universally.」

634:t_1:127.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Was he thinking of a time when we'd encounter something like the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$?」

634:t_1:129.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リボンズ$$, who knew $$イオリア$$'s plan, seemed interested in communicating with beings we couldn't speak to... other species.」

634:t_1:130.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ foresaw even the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ invasion...?」

634:t_1:131.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That isn't what I mean. ...He probably considered a situation like this arising when humanity eventually ventured into space.」

634:t_1:132.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$イノベイター$$s have the power meant for that time, then.」

634:t_1:133.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's only my speculation, of course.」

634:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But humans can understand one another by using words to the fullest, without $$精神感応波$$. So it's probably not entirely wrong.」

634:t_1:135.en:
$$イアン$$
「So $$刹那$$ advanced to a new stage according to $$イオリア$$'s plan...」

634:t_1:136.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It wasn't just the influence of GN particles. His loneliness was probably part of it too.」

634:t_1:138.en:
$$バナージ$$
「He doesn't look that way...」

634:t_1:140.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Yes... I understand what you're saying, Captain $$アムロ$$.」

634:t_1:141.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ were drawn to $$刹那$$ because of that too.」

634:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's right, $$刹那$$... Only you, who have always sought to understand others, can accomplish this mission.)

634:t_1:143.en:
$$アムロ$$
(So I'll be waiting for you to pilot this $$クアンタ$$.)

634:t_1:147.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not right, is it?」

634:t_1:148.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The Happy $$コーラサワー$$, then?」

634:t_1:149.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「This time I'm going with the Immortal $$コーラサワー$$.」

634:t_1:150.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「How about it, $$グラハム・エーカー$$? Team up with me, and some of my immortality will rub off on you.」

634:t_1:151.en:
$$グラハム$$
「So you see right through me...」

634:t_1:152.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Bushido is about dying or whatever, right? That stuff's out of fashion these days.」

634:t_1:153.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I don't know if you're atoning for the past or what, but if two guys with that attitude stick together, neither will come home.」

634:t_1:154.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So you see right through me as well.」

634:t_1:155.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Exactly. If you're picking a partner, pick me. Then you won't feel like throwing your life away.」

634:t_1:156.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I appreciate the sentiment, but...」

634:t_1:157.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You place a low value on your own life...」

634:t_1:159.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But no life is cheaper than mine.」

634:t_2:4.en:
$$刹那$$
(The sorrow... The pain, the suffering...! These are... all the feelings on this battlefield...!)

634:t_2:5.en:
$$刹那$$
(I... I... What should I do...!)

634:t_2:8.en:
$$リヒティ$$
(Everyone's still desperately clinging to life.)

634:t_2:9.en:
$$クリス$$
(They're trying to change the world.)

634:t_2:10.en:
$$刹那$$
($$リヒテンダール$$, $$クリスティナ$$...)
